episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Lee Yul begins a secret investigation after growing suspicious of his worsening health. Yun Hong Shim returns to Hanyang in search of her brother.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Yul uncovers the mastermind's identity and Kim So Hye's secret before coming under attack in the forest. Hong Shim is punished for refusing to wed.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Yul loses all memory, but gains a new identity as Na Won Deuk. Hong Shim begrudgingly chooses to become a wife to avoid life as a concubine.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Jung Je Yun searches for a link between the royal physician's murder and Yul's disappearance. Hong Shim puts Won Deuk to work to repay his debt.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: News of the crown prince's passing is made public. Hong Shim is delighted to learn of Won Deuk's ability to read and write.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Hong Shim's reunion with her brother doesn't go as expected. Eunuch Yang notices something off about the crown prince's dead body.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Witnessing Won Deuk's martial arts skills, Hong Shim gets curious about his real identity. News of the queen's talisman sparks protest and debate.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Won Deuk celebrates an unforgettable birthday. Moo Yun completes his final task for Kim Cha Eon and prepares to leave with Hong Shim.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Je Yoon reunites with Hong Shim as the new county governor. To recover his memory, Won Deuk visits Hanyang and enters palace walls.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: With Hong Shim and Won Deuk's help, Je Yoon concocts a plan to get in Park Sun Do's good graces. Rumors swirl about the crown prince being alive.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: The king tries to regain control of his throne. Hong Shim and Won Deuk settle their affairs prior to leaving. Je Yoon sees Yul in Won Duk.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Cha Eon interrupts the coronation ceremony with a shocking announcement. Yul has trouble moving on from his memories with Hong Shim.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Hong Shim searches for Moo Yun in Hanyang with her father and Je Yoon in tow. Yul's competency is tested by a visiting envoy.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Won Deuk and Hong Shim reconnect as Yul and Yoon Yi Seo. Je Yoon assists Yul in his quest to find his diary — and answers.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Having regained his memory, Yul seeks revenge on a killer in his midst. Cha Eon plans bloodshed to achieve his goals.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Cha Eon leaves behind his final wish. Moved by the king's hopes and Je Yoon's plan, Yul makes good on his promise to Yi Seo.
